keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Reid Roberts (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, FC Dallas 0, San Jose Earthquakes 0.
Second Half begins FC Dallas 0, San Jose Earthquakes 0.
Angus Gunn (San Jose Earthquakes) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, FC Dallas. Santiago Moreno replaces Joaquín Valiente.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Paul Marie replaces Jack Jasinski.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Niko Tsakiris replaces Ronaldo Vieira.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Vítor Costa replaces Jamar Ricketts.
Substitution, San Jose Earthquakes. Jack Skahan replaces Timo Werner.
Substitution, FC Dallas. Ran Binyamin replaces Herman Johansson.
Substitution, FC Dallas. Patrickson Delgado replaces Daniel Job.
Goal! FC Dallas 1, San Jose Earthquakes 0. Petar Musa (FC Dallas) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Bernard Kamungo.
Delay in match because of an injury Daniel (FC Dallas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! FC Dallas 2, San Jose Earthquakes 0. Petar Musa (FC Dallas) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
